name: FlowScribe Lite - AI Content Repurposing (4 Platforms)
description: Converts one blog post into four optimized social media posts for Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook using OpenAI.

inputs.system: Analyze the content and extract: 5 key points, core message in one sentence, 10 hashtags, 5 SEO keywords. Respond in JSON: { keyPoints, coreMessage, hashtags, seoKeywords }
Create a Twitter/X thread (5-7 tweets, each under 280 chars). First tweet: powerful hook. Last: CTA + hashtags. Use numbered format 1/, 2/. JSON: { "thread": ["tweet1", ...] }
Create a LinkedIn post: bold first line, short paragraphs, personal insight, end with question, 3-5 hashtags. 1300-1800 chars. JSON: { "post": "..." }
Create an Instagram caption: hook line, micro-story, emojis, CTA, 20-30 hashtags in separate block. JSON: { "caption": "...", "hashtags": [...] }
Create a Facebook post: relatable opening, story format, 100-250 words, conversation question at end, no external links, friendly tone. JSON: { "post": "..." }

setupVars.label: flowscribe sheet id (was the n8n environment variable FLOWSCRIBE_SHEET_ID)

source.path: Instagram_Twitter_Social_Media/FlowScribe Lite - AI Content Repurposing 4 Platforms.json

setup: "Receive Content" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value flowscribeSheetId: flowscribe sheet id (was the n8n environment variable FLOWSCRIBE_SHEET_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /flowscribe-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Validate Input" (code.require): Allowlisted require() calls were rewritten or dropped for Transform (no module system).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## FlowScribe Lite - Quick 4-Platform Repurpose

Simplified version with 4 core platforms:
Twitter/X | LinkedIn | Instagram | Facebook

Faster processing, lower API cost.
Ideal for daily content repurposing.
